aidgn.title: Aging-Informed Dynamic Graph Network for Aero-Engine RUL Prediction
aidgn.official_source_evidence: Author repository citation and author institutional publication record; full paper result table not obtained
aidgn.reported_metric_unit: cycles; author README report, not independently retrieved paper table
aidgn.core: Model/AIDGN.py: aging projection, two gated embeddings, dynamic adjacency, graph convolution, temporal/channel regression
aidgn.author_preprocessing: 14 sensors; operating-condition MinMax; cap125; overlapping-window random 90/10 validation split(seed42); observed cycle divided by mean training lifetime times1e-3; test final window with edge padding
aidgn.author_training: Adam lr.001; batch128; max300; patience10; nlayer1; hidden64; AATE10; window50
aidgn.checkpoint_selection: validation early stopping and reload best
aidgn.public_checkpoints: Upstream tree includes many .pth files; some belong to other models/datasets. No assumption that the README aggregate is reproducible from these files.
risks: overlapping train/validation engines
scaler and mean lifetime fitted before validation split
eager imports include absent AIGCN and unselected N-CMAPSS dependencies
upstream silently replaces nonfinite test outputs; reject such results
label column participates in scaler fitting; fragile surplus-column DataFrame assignment nevertheless ran unchanged in this environment

two_phase.title: A Two-Phase Equipment Remaining Useful Life Prediction Model With Sequence-Feature Attention Mechanism
two_phase.reported_metric_unit: published table not accessible; do not substitute third-party transcriptions

two_phase.author_training: hidden16,FFN32,MLP32,2 sequence heads and5 feature heads; batch256; pre20/100 epochs and fine200/600; fine lr.001/.0001; original seed529 replaced only by registered model seeds

transductive official-test feature statistics
hardcoded45 feature attention
original test DataLoader shuffles rows; recover and verify engine identities
negative original predictions clamped0 during author evaluation

dual_mixer.title: Supervised contrastive learning based dual-mixer model for Remaining Useful Life prediction

paper/code hyperparameters differ
normalized all-window paper metrics are not official-engine cycles metrics
short test engines dropped:6 FD002 and11 FD004
Gaussian sampler returns4 sampled windows for neg_num5 and the first is treated as anchor; preserved exactly
not an ensemble

ffve.title: Variational encoding based on factorized temporal-channel fusion and feature fusion for interpretable remaining useful life prediction

ffve.author_preprocessing: 14 sensors; condition StandardScaler fitted before engine split; engine80/20seed42; alpha.1 exponential smoothing; window30; cap125; final test window with zero pad

validation-engine covariates used in scaler

unused FFVE wrapper passes nonexistent Encoder hidden_dim; original main correctly uses Encoder+Decoder separately
